title: Client
problem: A 2016 Ionic app where a critical booking journey took 12–20 s.
action: Led the migration to native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin); moved regression testing to Compose Testing + XCUITest.
story: My manager asked for a benchmark: the Ionic app against native. I ran it and presented the numbers. This dyno replays it.
Speed is only what a dyno measures. Going native also put the app closer to the hardware, opening the door to wearables.
